configurePresets.name: vcpkg-base
configurePresets.description: Shared vcpkg wiring (issue #773). Requires the VCPKG_ROOT environment variable to point at a bootstrapped vcpkg clone — see docs/ops/build.md. VCPKG_HOST_TRIPLET is pinned to the MSVC triplet on purpose: host tools (notably protoc) are then built ONCE and shared by both the msvc and clangcl trees instead of once per target triplet.

configurePresets.name: msvc
configurePresets.description: Default MSVC build using Visual Studio generator

configurePresets.name: clangcl
configurePresets.description: Clang-cl compiler via Ninja — catches Clang warnings with MSVC ABI. The clang-cl toolchain is CHAINLOADED (VCPKG_CHAINLOAD_TOOLCHAIN_FILE) rather than being the toolchainFile, because that slot now belongs to vcpkg.cmake. NOTE the triplet is the plain MSVC one: this preset compiles OUR code with clang-cl, but the third-party PORTS are shared with the msvc tree — see docs/agent-rules/vcpkg-dependency-management.md for the evidence behind that.

configurePresets.name: dev-cached
configurePresets.displayName: Dev: Ninja + compiler cache (shared across worktrees)
configurePresets.description: The fast local-dev preset. Ninja Multi-Config because CMAKE_<LANG>_COMPILER_LAUNCHER is honoured ONLY by the Ninja and Makefile generators — the Visual Studio generator ignores it, so the 'msvc' preset can never cache however the tools are configured. Measured 2026-08-19 building target OloEngine at b4f7213e: a cold tree took 12m04s (689 TUs, 100% cacheable, 0 hits); a SECOND WORKTREE at the same commit took 3m23s with 689/689 hits, 95% of them ccache direct hits. That cross-worktree sharing is the point — six worktrees otherwise recompile near-identical trees from scratch. Needs the cache tool configured for cross-directory sharing (ccache: base_dir + hash_dir=false; sccache: SCCACHE_BASEDIRS) and pinned via the OLO_COMPILER_CACHE_TOOL environment variable; see cmake/CompilerCache.cmake. Its own binaryDir on purpose: enabling the cache force-disables PCH and unity builds, so it must not share a build tree with 'clangcl'.

configurePresets.name: linux-gcc
configurePresets.description: Base Linux preset using GCC 14 and Ninja Multi-Config. Uses vcpkg's stock x64-linux triplet (static libs, no CRT-linkage concept) rather than a custom one — the static-md triplets exist only to pin the Windows CRT choice.

configurePresets.name: linux-gcc-toolset
configurePresets.description: For distros where the compiler is `gcc`/`g++` on PATH rather than versioned gcc-14 binaries — e.g. an activated RHEL/Rocky gcc-toolset-N. Shares build-linux/ with linux-gcc, so use one or the other. FFmpeg is off by default (its from-source build needs nasm); enable with -DOLO_VIDEO_FFMPEG=ON once nasm is installed. Pass -DCMAKE_PREFIX_PATH=$VULKAN_SDK for the shader stack. See docs/ops/build.md.

configurePresets.name: linux-asan
configurePresets.description: GCC ASan build; also enables LSan automatically per cmake/Sanitizers.cmake.

configurePresets.name: linux-ubsan
configurePresets.description: GCC Undefined Behavior Sanitizer build (no ASan).

configurePresets.name: linux-tsan
configurePresets.description: GCC Thread Sanitizer build (incompatible with ASan). cmake/Sanitizers.cmake force-disables Tracy when OLO_ENABLE_TSAN is on — Tracy's rpmalloc has a known static-init-order race that TSan halts on. So plain `cmake -DOLO_ENABLE_TSAN=ON` also gets the right behaviour, not just this preset.

buildPresets.name: clangcl-asan-release
buildPresets.description: Project uses Debug/Release/Dist (see cmake/SetupConfigurations.cmake); Release already includes PDB debug info on MSVC.

buildPresets.name: dev-cached-debug
buildPresets.description: Debug build through the compiler cache. Still route it through the build mutex — the cache makes a build cheaper, not free, and a cold tree is a full build.
